channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Donald Sterling | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Donald Sterling from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JJ Redick on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“We had a charity golf tournament at Palos Verdes at the Trump Course there and that was the only interaction I ever had with him (Donald Sterling),”

JJ Redick on Donald Sterling, Jun 15, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: JJ Redick on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“We had a charity golf tournament at Palos Verdes at the Trump Course there and that was the only interaction I ever had with him (Donald Sterling). This was after he tried to cancel my deal because he woke up and decided he didn’t want to sign a white player. I went up to him just to say hello and I said hey Mr. Sterling, ‘nice to meet you', and he said ‘hey JJ I’ve heard a lot about you.' That was the only words I ever spoke to him.”

JJ Redick on Donald Sterling, Jun 14, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“It didn't necessarily surprise me. To meI just thought that Donald Sterling was the only one dumb enough to get caught. But there is definitely owners that still have the same views or mentality and that's kind of just that good ol' boy generation.”

Matt Barnes on Donald Sterling, Jul 1, 2020. Source: 957 The Game.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver
item.description:
“Look at the Donald Sterling situation. The NBA has cachet in our community. When something happens in the black community, the NBA has always been there. [Commissioner] Adam [Silver] is the most dynamic leader we have in sports. He gets it. It's a no-brainer. I knew he was going to do something.”

Magic Johnson on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver, Apr 16, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Ralph Lawler on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“Then it’s time for Kobe to excuse himself and go and Donald Sterling walks him to the door expressing concern. ‘Is this really going to happen?’“Kobe turned to him and — this is an exact quote that I’ve had repeated to me by multiple people — he said, ‘Don’t worry, I’m a Clipper.’ So he walked out the door and [the Clippers] are all high-fiving each other thinking, ‘By God, we’ve done it.’“If anybody denies any of that,”

Ralph Lawler on Donald Sterling, Jul 26, 2019. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Adam Silver on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Barbara Barker:Adam Silver on how he felt a year ago dealing with Sterling:

“I felt the weight of the entire institution of the NBA on me.”

Adam Silver on Donald Sterling, Apr 23, 2015. Source: Twitter @meanbarb.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Clippers PFBlake Griffin on present owner Steve Balmer and past owner Donald Sterling:

“Steve is a good dude. He's like a cool dad who gives you candy. Donald was like a weird uncle.”

Blake Griffin on Donald Sterling, Oct 18, 2014. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Billy King on Danny Ferry, Donald Sterling
item.description:
“That was one of the problems I had. Everybody was attacking him without knowing him. Magic probably met him but he didn’t really know him. That’s what happens. You have to know the person before you label him something. Like Donald Sterling, everybody knew that’s who he was. That’s why so many of us came out so strongly (in support) because we have a long history of knowing (Ferry).”

Billy King on Danny Ferry, Donald Sterling, Sep 25, 2014. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“And maybe even a higher standard just because kids look up to us, and we’re trying to set those examples every day. So it reminds us all, I think, in pro sports that we’ve got to use our positions wisely and finish everything through. We just finished all of our sensitivity, diversity, anti-harassment training – a serious training – early spring this year, right before the Donald Sterling thing all came out. We do that every year, but we’re going to have to stay on our guard and make sure we do the best they can.”

Wyc Grousbeck on Donald Sterling, Sep 23, 2014. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Adam Silver on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“I can say with certainty, we are doing everything in our power to move Donald out as an owner in the NBA. If the probate ruling doesn’t go in our favor, we’ll recommence our procedures under termination.”

Adam Silver on Donald Sterling, Jul 16, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bobby Samini on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“I think Donald did an excellent job on the stand. . . . If I needed a lawyer, I'd hire him,”

Bobby Samini on Donald Sterling, Jul 9, 2014. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Dwain Price:Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Donald Sterling:

“The NBA has been my life and I do not want some racist clown being the face of the NBA.”

Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Donald Sterling, Jun 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Adam Silver on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“So in essence, Donald is suing himself and he knows that. While I understand he is frustrated, I think it's over. I think it's just a matter of time now, and then we will move on to better topics and back to the Finals.”

Adam Silver on Donald Sterling, Jun 8, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“Our position is under the constitution, based on Mr. Sterling’s conduct, if the owners ultimately decide that it is appropriate to terminate his franchise, the interest of all owners is terminated,”

Adam Silver on Donald Sterling, May 21, 2014. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Adam Silver on Kevin Durant, Donald Sterling
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Adam Silver:

“Kevin Durant as our Most Valuable Player embodies what our league is all about. And quite frankly, Mr. Sterling doesn't”

Adam Silver on Kevin Durant, Donald Sterling, May 20, 2014. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Amar’e Stoudemire and embattled Los Angeles Clippers owner Donald Sterling don’t exactly see eye to eye, but the Knicks forward does agree with Sterling about one thing.

“There is a lot going on, but I do agree with Donald Sterling that us NBA players have to step up and do more for our community,”

Amare Stoudemire on Donald Sterling, May 20, 2014. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: JJ Redick on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Redick on Sterling:

“I can’t imagine a scenario where we start the season next year and he’s the owner and all is kosher.”

JJ Redick on Donald Sterling, May 16, 2014. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Steve Blake on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Blake on Sterling remaining owner:

“I don’t think that’s an ideal situation for us to start next season with that still going on.”

Steve Blake on Donald Sterling, May 16, 2014. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Donald Sterling
item.description:
He also said Sterling wanted Johnson to appear with him in an interview with ABC's Barbara Walters but Johnson refused.

“Donald Sterling reached out to me, I took the call. I'm the one, when he wanted me to go on Barbara Walters with him and try to save him and his reputation, I told him I would not go on the show with him and I told him you should seek the advice of your attorney and try to make this thing go away,”

Magic Johnson on Donald Sterling, May 13, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Hakeem Olajuwon on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Mark Berman:Hakeem Olajuwon on NBA sanctions on Donald Sterling:

“I think it's very important to send that message just for everybody to learn from that”

Hakeem Olajuwon on Donald Sterling, Apr 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Herb Kohl on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Bucks owner Herb Kohl:

“We denounce the offensive, racist comments made by Mr. Sterling and we stand with the actions Commissioner Silver has taken against him.”

Herb Kohl on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver, Apr 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Herb Simon on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver
item.description:
Herb Simon:

“I wholeheartedly endorse Commissioner Adam Silver’s swift, strong and decisive action with regard to Donald Sterling. These past days have been both sad and disturbing for the NBA family. It is our responsibility to continue as models of the diversity and inclusion the NBA has long and justly represented.”

Herb Simon on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver, Apr 29, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kevin Johnson on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Baxter Holmes:Kevin Johnson:

“I hope every bigot in this country sees what happens to Mr. Sterling and recognizes that if he can fall, so can you.”

Kevin Johnson on Donald Sterling, Apr 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @BaxterHolmes.

item.title: Paul Allen on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver
item.description:
Joe Freeman:#Blazers owner Paul Allen:

“I completely support Adam Silver's decisive action on the Sterling issue. He exhibited great leadership and the league is in good hands.”

Paul Allen on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver, Apr 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.

item.title: Robert Sarver on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver
item.description:
Paul Coro:Statement from #Suns Managing Partner Robert Sarver:

“I applaud the actions taken today by Commissioner Silver in response to the disturbing comments made by Donald Sterling. Commissioner Silver’s decision upholds the principles of diversity, and respect for all people that the NBA and Phoenix Suns represent. The Commissioner has my full support.”

Robert Sarver on Donald Sterling, Adam Silver, Apr 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:Pop on the Donald Sterling situation:

“It's something that has to be handled. We have full faith that the NBA will react appropriately.”

Gregg Popovich on Donald Sterling, Apr 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Donald Sterling
item.description:
“Donald Sterling is making a lot of money based on the performance and intelligence of black men and yet -- if these comments are authentic -- he still holds these views and clearly doesn't respect them as people because of the color of their skin.”

Stan Van Gundy on Donald Sterling, Apr 28, 2014. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Donald Sterling
item.description:
said Lillard,who learned of the story on Twitter.

“I wasn't even aware of who (Sterling) was by name. I think because (racism) goes so far back in our history, that maybe people might think that it doesn't exist. But there might be some people still out there that feel that way.”

Damian Lillard on Donald Sterling, Apr 27, 2014. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Donald Sterling
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on Sterling situation:

“I’m glad Doc is the guy that’s there to handle it. Because he will.”

Tom Thibodeau on Donald Sterling, Apr 27, 2014. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Adam Silver on Donald Sterling
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:Adam Silver:

“I'm not prepared to discuss any potential sanctions against Donald Sterling. We will, however, move quickly.”

Adam Silver on Donald Sterling, Apr 26, 2014. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.
